definitions.gloss: trash bag; garbage bag; rubbish bag
definitions.explanation: A bag used for collecting and disposing of garbage. In many Japanese municipalities, designated bags must be purchased and used for trash collection.

examples.english: Please put burnable and non-burnable garbage in separate trash bags.

notes:
Compound of ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (garbage/trash) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). In Japan, many municipalities require residents to purchase designated trash bags (⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}) sold at convenience stores and supermarkets. These bags are often color-coded by trash type (burnable, non-burnable, recyclable).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}: designated trash bag
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in a trash bag
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put out a trash bag (for collection)
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縛|しば}る→縛る：03925_shibaru⟧: to tie up a trash bag

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's strict garbage separation system means households typically keep multiple types of ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}. The rules vary by municipality and are a common topic of daily life, especially for newcomers.
